about: Palm modelled as a generic product: mulch ring, root boss, tall trunk with leaf-scar rings (the 9 m type has a longer trunk under the same crown), crown shaft, four arching fronds on the main axes and four diagonal fronds in three drooping segments, a skirt of old frond bases, two spear fronds, two fruit clusters. Each type has its own parts where the types differ (Show parameters).
